title: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti [page 216] 216 DIṬṬHI-SAṂYUTTAM [XXIV. 17. 3-15 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || 3-15 Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || pa || niyato saṃbodhiparāyano ti || ||
